name: Call Of God The
overview: The Call of God invites individuals to join in fellowship and shared purpose, yet Proverbs 1:14-19 warns against following the path of the wicked who rush into evil and destruction for selfish gain. These verses illustrate the danger of heeding the wrong call, which leads to ruin, contrasting with the true call that comes from God and offers life. The call is not only a summons but a test of discernment between the way of death and the way of righteousness.
